name: Mail
tip: Encrypted direct messages. Every message is a NOSTR note addressed to a person's key, carried over both the internet and the Reticulum mesh.

children.name: new_message
children.tip: Start a conversation — npub, hex key, a callsign, or an email address to look up

name: Email
tip: Your email identity. People who only have your email address reach this device when the address's domain lists your key (NIP-05: /.well-known/nostr.json).

name: Blocked
tip: People whose messages are dropped on arrival. Local only — nothing is sent, and they are not told.

name: Status
tip: Where your messages are going, and what came back.
